title: ROGERRR Auto Farm
script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "+1 Katana Evolution | By ROGERRR144",
    LoadingTitle = "+1 Katana Evolution",
    LoadingSubtitle = "By ROGERRR144",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = false
    },
    Discord = {
        Enabled = false
    },
    KeySystem = false
})

local Main = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)

local Mode = "Teleport"
local Farming = false

Main:CreateDropdown({
    Name = "Farm Mode",
    Options = {"Teleport", "Tween"},
    CurrentOption = "Teleport",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Mode = Value
    end,
})

Main:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Auto Farm",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        Farming = Value

        while Farming do
            local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
            local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
            local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("WinCollectors")
            if folder then
                local stage = folder:FindFirstChild("Stage25")
                if stage then
                    local button = stage:FindFirstChild("Button")

                    if button and hrp then
                        if Mode == "Teleport" then
                            hrp.CFrame = button.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,3,0)
                        else
                            local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
                            local distance = (hrp.Position - button.Position).Magnitude
                            local tween = TweenService:Create(
                                hrp,
                                TweenInfo.new(distance/100, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
                                {CFrame = button.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,3,0)}
                            )
                            tween:Play()
                            tween.Completed:Wait()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end,
})

Main:CreateLabel("By ROGERRR144")
features: Auto Farm Script For + 1 Katana Evolution with options including Tween and Teleport (WIP)
